package example
import "testing"
func TestChildren(t *testing.T) {
 t.Run("first", func(t *testing.T) {
  if 2+3 != 5 { t.Fatal("addition") }
 })
 t.Run("logging", func(t *testing.T) {
  t.Log("require.Equal is only text")
 })
 t.Run("third", func(t *testing.T) {
  if 2*3 != 6 { t.Fatal("multiply") }
 })
}
